chapterTitle: Unit 01: The Science of Biology & Scientific Method
description: Introduction to biological science, major branches (morphology, physiology, histology, genetics), Quranic references, scientific problem-solving, and levels of biological organization.
Need for classification, two-to-five kingdom systems, three domains of life, taxonomic hierarchy, binomial nomenclature, viral nature, and biodiversity conservation.

chapterTitle: Unit 03: The Cell: Structure, Functions & Organelles
description: Cell theory, microscopy, cellular ultrastructure (nucleus, mitochondria, ribosomes, plastids, ER, Golgi, lysosomes), cytoskeleton, and plant vs animal cells.

chapterTitle: Unit 04: Cell Cycle: Mitosis, Meiosis & Cell Division
description: Phases of the cell cycle (Interphase G1, S, G2), mitosis (karyokinesis & cytokinesis), meiosis I and II, crossing over, significance of division, and apoptosis.
Plant tissues (meristematic, permanent, xylem, phloem) and animal tissues (epithelial, connective, muscular, nervous), organ architecture, and system integration.
Major organic compounds: carbohydrates (monosaccharides, disaccharides, polysaccharides), proteins, lipids, nucleic acids (DNA double helix, RNA), and ATP.
Characteristics of enzymes, activation energy, lock-and-key model, induced-fit model, factors affecting enzyme action (pH, temperature), and metabolic pathways.
Plant mineral nutrition (macronutrients, micronutrients), photosynthesis (light & dark reactions), respiration, water uptake, osmosis, and transpiration.
Asexual reproduction (vegetative propagation), sexual reproduction in flowering plants, structure of flower, pollination, double fertilization, and seed germination.
Sources of genetic variation, gene mutations, Darwin's theory of natural selection, homologous and analogous structures, speciation, and evolutionary evidence.
